questions.text: Which organelle is the main site of ATP synthesis in a eukaryotic cell?
questions.explanation: Oxidative phosphorylation happens on the inner mitochondrial membrane.

questions.text: A solution of pH 3 is how many times more acidic than a solution of pH 5?
questions.explanation: pH is logarithmic: two pH units = a hundredfold difference in hydrogen ion concentration.

questions.text: Which base is found in RNA but not in DNA?
questions.explanation: RNA pairs uracil with adenine where DNA uses thymine.

questions.text: Select every component of a nucleotide.

questions.text: How many chromosomes are in a normal human somatic cell?
questions.explanation: 23 pairs: 22 autosomal pairs plus one sex chromosome pair.

questions.text: A 180-minute paper has 60 equally weighted questions. What is the average time per question, in minutes?
questions.explanation: 180 divided by 60 is 3 minutes per question.
